key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the European AI Office within DG CONNECT of the Commission
Tasks include implementing and enforcing the forthcoming AI Act, especially rules on general-purpose AI models
Develops tools, benchmarks and evaluation methods for GPAI models with systemic risks
Provides secretariat to the AI Board, supports sandboxes, codes of practice and standardisation requests
Promotes trustworthy AI, innovation and international cooperation; funded via Digital Europe Programme
annotation.summary_en: Commission Decision establishing the European AI Office within DG CONNECT, tasked with implementing and enforcing the forthcoming AI Act (notably general-purpose AI models), coordinating governance structures, supporting codes of practice and sandboxes, and advancing international cooperation and trustworthy AI innovation.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Decision of 24 January 2024 establishing the European Artificial Intelligence Office
annotation.title_en: Commission Decision of 24 January 2024 establishing the European Artificial Intelligence Office
